summary: Deep Analytics v1.13.15 regression + new-feature test PASSED end-to-end. Backend pytest: 9 passed / 1 skipped (0 failures) — /app/backend/tests/test_deep_analytics_v1_13_15.py. Verified: (a) service deep-analytics response contains returns[] + complaints[] + kpis.returns_count + kpis.complaints_count with all documented fields (user_name, phone, reason, status, amount, created_at for returns; user_name, text, category, status, reply, created_at for complaints); picked service 6ab6206a71b6ad54069c12ce has r=2 c=3, and 10+ services expose non-empty returns/complaints combined (>=26 returns and >=25 complaints total across all services, matching seed target). (b) competition deep-analytics response contains winners[] with (user_name, rank, prize_value, claim_status, city, prize_name, announced_at) AND videos[] with (title, url, thumbnail, duration, views) — all 5 sampled competitions returned winners_count 3-5 and videos_count 2-4 matching the spec. kpis.videos_count and kpis.winners_count both present. (c) social posts count = 56 (>= 50 requirement). Sample post 6ab706773c61931724b7ab9d exposes likes_total, comments_total, reach_estimate KPIs. Frontend UI (mobile 390x844, Expo web): Service analytics screen renders 5 KPI rows with 5th row exactly 'طلبات إرجاع' + 'الشكاوى'; tab bar shows 'الإرجاعات' and 'الشكاوى'; KPI subtitles use correct Arabic terminology (مشاهدات الخدمة / الحجوزات with '% معدل الحجز' — NO 'أضيف للسلة' leaking). Competition analytics screen renders 5 KPI rows with 5th row 'الفائزون' + 'فيديوهات ترويجية' (5/100 winners, 4 videos), participants subtitle '% معدل المشاركة', tab bar contains 'الفائزون' and 'الفيديوهات', winners tab shows prize value in ريال + city + claim status pill, videos tab shows 'محفوظ للأبد' note + duration badge + views count. Post analytics screen renders 5 KPI rows with 5th row 'التعليقات' + 'معدل التفاعل', likes KPI subtitle correctly reads '1.96% من الوصول' (NOT 'تحويل'). Number formatter working: 17.8K / 34.5K / 24.9K / 2.2K / 1.3K all visible on-screen with no overflow. No 'أضيف للسلة' leaking into service, competition, or post screens.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: add testID attributes to product-analytics.tsx tabs (returns/complaints/winners/videos) so future regressions can be selector-driven rather than Arabic-text-driven.

Optional: extract the K/M formatter (product-analytics.tsx:97-104) into a shared util so revenue's inline formatter at line 236 uses the same threshold consistently (current inline uses >=1000 for K, while fmt() uses >=10000 for K — behaves fine for values<10000 but inconsistent semantically).

critical_code_review_comments: product-analytics.tsx is 775 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting KPI grid, tab renderer, and StyleSheet into modules.
deep_analytics.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id in all payloads. New fields (returns_count, complaints_count, winners_count, videos_count) are additive and non-breaking.

The revenue conditional K formatter at product-analytics.tsx:236 uses `>= 1000` threshold, whereas the fmt() util uses `>= 10_000`. Behaviour is fine for the tested data but inconsistent — unify via fmt().
seed_rich_content.py is idempotent (guards on existing counts) — safe to re-run on production DB without duplication.
